label: BFL / FLUX Image Generation
description: Black Forest Labs API for image generation and editing via FLUX models.

aspects.name: essentials
attributes: Default model: flux-2-pro-preview (use for everything unless told otherwise)
Other models: flux-kontext-pro, flux-kontext-max, flux-pro-1.1, flux-2-pro
Submit: POST https://api.bfl.ai/v1/{model} with JSON body
Response has polling_url — ALWAYS use it (may point to regional node like api.us2.bfl.ai)
Poll the polling_url with X-Key header until status="Ready"
Image URL at result.sample — NOT result.url or result.image_url
Signed URLs expire ~1hr — download or display promptly

aspects.name: parameters
attributes: Optional: width, height, output_format ("jpeg" or "png"), seed
Image editing: add input_image param (URL, raw base64, or data URI all work)
Edit prompts: describe what CHANGED, not the full scene
Typical generation: 5-15 seconds. Poll every 3s, timeout at 60s.

aspects.name: display_rule
attributes: Always show generated images inline in chat: ![description](result.sample URL)
Do NOT just report a file path — the user wants to SEE the image
